question: Refer to the exhibit. A network engineer must SPAN only the ingress traffic of a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch from interface fc 1/23 to interface fc 1/24. Which two configurations must be applied to complete this task? (Choose two.)
context:
interface fc 1/24
-- output omitted --
no shutdown
span session 1
-- output omitted --
destination interface fc 1/24
theory: To SPAN only ingress (Rx) traffic from fc1/23 to a dedicated analyzer port, the destination interface (fc1/24) must be put into SD (SPAN Destination) port mode, and the source must be explicitly scoped to the ingress direction with 'source interface fc1/23 rx' - omitting the 'rx' qualifier would span both directions, and configuring 'tx' would capture egress traffic instead of the required ingress traffic. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - SPAN)
